correctness.rationale: For all integers n>=h>=2, equal sliding sums imply d_(i+h)=d_i and equal initial sum; conversely these two conditions force all reads equal. Each residue-column difference is constant; for binary inputs mixed columns force zero change and pure columns may switch all-zero/all-one preserving their one-column count. This is a complete bijection from fibers to choices of t among p pure columns, giving binomial fibers. Weighted selection over pure subsets yields the full distribution; evaluation and derivative of product_j(b_j+z) gives the exact total, singleton and nontrivial counts. The maximum follows from binomial unimodality and all-pure attainable sources. Explicit independent exhaustive source enumeration through n=15 and large exact identities agree; computations corroborate and do not replace the proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General algebraic partition and inverse algorithms do not supply the exact finite all-parameter number and full fiber spectrum in their stated results. The 2024 work studies asymptotic read capacity with shifts. The published cyclic exact theorem covers a distinct wraparound map and does not imply the nondivisibility mixed residue-column count. The underlying binary rigidity is not asserted to be a new general mechanism.

originality.rationale: The primary 2022 source studies exactly these indexed nonwrapping overlapping binary histograms, gives three special-parameter cases and explicitly identifies the absence of a closed formula for the number of metameric classes (Section 4.4). The source full text does not state this all-length/all-width census or full fiber distribution. A published cyclic read theorem gives a related pure/mixed binomial classification but requires wraparound and has gcd(n,h), not h, residue cycles. Its statement does not yield the mixed-length noncyclic formula for h not dividing n. A 2022 follow-up and a 2024 weighted-read paper do not give an exact equivalent finite result. This PASS is qualified: equivalences outside inspected primary sources may exist; priority is not certified.

value.rationale: The exact number of binary local-histogram metameric classes for general window/source lengths was explicitly posed as an open finite enumeration problem in the 2022 motivating primary paper. This resolves it and supplies the complete inverse-list spectrum, exact unique-reconstruction population, optimal noiseless zero-error code size and sharp maximum list size. Natural channel and parameters, rather than an unmotivated finite slice. Does not assert extension to nonbinary/noisy observations.
